text: Decision: from 2026-01-01 we keep shipment tracking events for 24 months for every customer, including Brisklane customers (they were on Brisklane's 12 months). I will update the Data Retention Policy in Confluence. The Brisklane Notion handbook is read-only and will not be updated.
Works for us. Brisklane contracts never promised 12 months, so no customer notice is needed.
